originality.rationale: PASS with best-of-knowledge qualification. Its public full text was inspected; the inspected paper derives and tabulates covering configurations/numerical values rather than the complete exact fixed-site uncovered-area CDF and local quadratic coefficient. General random-center sphere-coverage laws by Bürgisser–Cucker–Lotz do not directly describe these deterministic sites. General Voronoi algorithms could reconstruct the same distribution, but a computational method without an explicit demonstrated implication is not automatically the claimed exact formula.
